title: Vietnam Sightseeing with Phong Nha
alt: Boat entering the mouth of Phong Nha cave in Quang Binh
transport: Flights, private transfers and guided day tours

stops.name: Hanoi
stops.subtitle: Hanoi and Ninh Binh
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast and dinner · Standard room · 3★ · Small boutique hotel in the old quarter

activities.name: Ninh Binh day tour
activities.description: South to Ninh Binh for a rowing boat through the flooded caves at Tam Coc and the limestone country around it.

activities.name: Cycle ride to Bich Dong pagoda
activities.description: A cycle ride through the rice fields to Bich Dong, a three tier pagoda built into the rock face.

program.name: Hanoi
program.description: Two nights in the old quarter, with a full day south to Ninh Binh and a cycle ride to Bich Dong.

stops.name: Halong Bay
stops.accom: 1 night · All meals · Cabin with a window · 3★ · Timber cruise boat moored among the karsts overnight

activities.name: Halong Bay overnight cruise
activities.description: A shared cruise out among the limestone islands, with lunch and dinner on board and a night moored in a quiet bay.

program.name: Halong Bay
program.description: A night on the water among the limestone islands, with all meals served on board.

stops.name: Dong Hoi
stops.subtitle: Dong Hoi and the Phong Nha caves
stops.hotel: Phong Nha Lake House Resort, Vietnam
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Lakeside resort in the Phong Nha valley, among the karst hills

activities.name: Surprise Cave on Bo Hon island
activities.description: A morning climb into the Surprise Cave, three great chambers of stalactites above the water, before the boat turns back.

activities.name: Phong Nha cave day tour
activities.match: Full Day Phong Nha Cave Tour
activities.description: A boat into the mouth of Phong Nha, one of the great river caves of the world, through chambers the river has cut for millions of years.

activities.name: Dark Cave with the mud bath
activities.description: A zip line across the river into the Dark Cave, then a wade and a swim through the mud pools inside it.

program.name: Dong Hoi
program.description: Two nights in the Phong Nha valley for the great river cave and the mud pools of the Dark Cave.

stops.name: Da Nang
stops.subtitle: Da Nang and Ba Na Hills
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast and dinner · Standard room · 3★ · Simple hotel a few streets back from My Khe beach

activities.name: Ba Na Hills and the Golden Bridge
activities.match: Ba Na Hills and Golden Bridge Day Tour
activities.description: The long cable car up to Ba Na, the Golden Bridge held up by two stone hands, and the French village and gardens at the top.

program.name: Da Nang
program.description: South to the coast for two nights near the beach, with a full day up at Ba Na Hills.

stops.name: Ho Chi Minh City
stops.hotel: Avanti Saigon Hotel, Ho Chi Minh
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Small hotel in District 1, a short walk from the opera house

activities.name: Cu Chi tunnels half day tour
activities.match: Cu Chi Tunnel Half Day Tour
activities.description: The tunnel network north west of the city, with the trapdoors, the kitchens and a crawl through a widened section of the original shafts.

program.name: Ho Chi Minh City
program.description: The flight south for a last night, with the Cu Chi tunnels on the way in.

A rowing boat through the flooded caves at Tam Coc
A cycle ride through the rice fields
Bich Dong, a pagoda built into the rock
3: Breakfast and check out, then east towards the coast
Board your cruise boat in the early afternoon
A night moored among the limestone islands

Back to the pier and on to Hanoi

Check in at the lakeside resort in the valley

expert.name: Riya
expert.quote: Phong Nha is the reason to take this one. Almost no itinerary stops in Quang Binh and the caves there are the biggest in the world.
expert.tip: Wear clothes you do not mind ruining on the Dark Cave day. The mud does not come out of anything pale.

summary: Nine days with a stop almost nobody makes: Hanoi with Ninh Binh and a Bich Dong cycle ride, an overnight cruise in Halong Bay, two nights in the Phong Nha valley for the great river cave and the Dark Cave mud pools, two in Da Nang for Ba Na Hills, then Saigon and the Cu Chi tunnels.
included: Included: 8 nights with breakfast daily, dinner at the Hanoi and Da Nang hotels and all meals on the cruise boat; flights and transfers throughout; a Ninh Binh day tour; a cycle ride to Bich Dong; a shared overnight cruise in Halong Bay with the Surprise Cave; a full day Phong Nha cave tour; the Dark Cave with the mud bath; a full day up at Ba Na with the Golden Bridge; the Cu Chi tunnels half day tour.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Vietnam visa fees; lunches other than on the cruise; travel insurance; personal expenses.
